mapper.select: /* LeaveConversionPolicyMapper.selectConversionHistory */ SELECT P.APPLY_FROM_DATE AS applyFromDate , P.DAILY_CONV_MINUTES AS dailyConvMinutes , P.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS insertDate , P.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updateDate FROM TB_LEAVE_CONVERSION_POLICY P WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY P.APPLY_FROM_DATE DESC
